item.title: macci 2.8.0
item.description:
macci 2.8.0

  • Cloudee runs simple commands directly — “open Safari”, “quit Notes”, “switch to Mail”, “type …”, “write a note that says …” — with no model round-trip.
  • Point at an app by name: “circle the Notes app” finds its window and marks it.
  • The on-screen pointer grounds on on-device OCR and knows your real display size, for accurate arrows and boxes.
  • Web search built in (no key) — ask for anything current and Cloudee looks it up and cites sources; point it at a SearXNG URL in Settings for a reliable feed.
  • Bring your own AI provider & model (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Gemini) or use the built-in default; on-device fallback when the cloud is unreachable.
  • Coding-assistant usage rings in the notch — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GLM, Grok, OpenCode — click one for the per-window breakdown.
  • One pointer gesture: hold ⌃⌥ and circle a region, then tell Cloudee what you want.
  • Reworked onboarding with a hands-on AI tour, a plan picker, and a 7-day free trial.
  • Folder-backed Skills: drop in a folder with SKILL.md + reference docs, or import a Markdown file.
  • Fixes: subscription checkout, the updater feed, and app-launch reliability.
